decisions.reason: Because this system builds on the firm’s core coating equipment capabilities in a growing industry, management would likely tolerate some early uncertainty despite its narrower niche and only modest website prominence.
As a close extension of the established offer with a dedicated product page, this pump is likely seen as meeting or being close to aspiration levels and worth retaining.
This transfer pump fits well with existing products and in-house know-how, so with available organizational slack the firm would likely continue it unless clear underperformance emerges.

Although somewhat more uncertain as a monitoring solution, it supports the firm’s direction toward future-oriented and interoperable systems and is therefore likely to be kept while results are still forming.
